description: #749 adjacency-is-not-flow negative controls: an adjacent untrusted-source assignment whose target the construction never uses (request_id near a constant join), an untrusted token with no assignment target at all, and a trusted-anchor call whose operand is assigned from a NON-untrusted adjacent line are all trusted/clean — path_handling must not fire and the provenance artifact stays empty. Co-occurrence never substitutes for the one-hop def/use edge.
